---
name: Wrong label or removal request
about: An issue is in the wrong sample, or you want an issue removed from this copy
labels: data
---

**Which issue?** (e.g. TeamNewPipe/NewPipe#13993)

**What is wrong, or why should it be removed?**
For example: "a release note, not an accessibility report", or "I filed it and want it out of this copy".

Note: the samples are weak labels by design (see "Known label noise" in the README). A wrong
label is recorded as known noise; it is not hand-corrected in the data, so the pipeline stays
reproducible. Removal requests from the person who filed an issue are honoured.
